value.body: Experienced merchant navy officers teach at DG Shipping-approved maritime training institutes, running pre-sea courses for cadets, competency (CoC) preparation courses and short safety and refresher courses. It is a shore-based move that uses sea experience and certificates.

items.label: Trainer course
items.note: Required for faculty at approved institutes under DGS orders

items.label: Typical requirement
items.value: Master / Chief Engineer CoC + years of sea service
items.note: Exact certificate and sea-time depend on the course taught

items.label: DGS-approved maritime training institutes
items.note: Counts differ slightly by source and date
items.source: Lok Sabha reply, July 2026; DG Shipping inspection programme report, July 2025 (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Hold the certificate of competency and sea service the institute's DGS-approved course requires (senior courses usually need a management-level CoC such as Master or Chief Engineer). Complete a DGS-approved TOTA course, then apply to institutes; many also hire for specific short courses.

value.title: At a glance
items: Shore-based life and regular hours, in exchange for lower pay than senior sea positions.
Faculty rules (certificates, sea-time, age) are set in DGS circulars and can change.
Related shore roles include assessor, superintendent and marine surveyor posts.
